spec.name: Organic Textured Stone Bowl
spec.proportions: 35 cm diameter by 10 cm height, wide and low-profile

parts.shape: Irregular organic shallow vessel with undulating thick rim
parts.material: Porous cast stone or carved sandstone
parts.finish: Rough hand-chiseled exterior with matte smoothed interior

spec.studio_prompt: A low-profile organic stone bowl measuring approximately 35 cm in diameter and 10 cm in height. The monolithic vessel features a soft, irregular circular silhouette with an undulating, sculpted rim and an empty basin. Crafted from heavy matte stone, the exterior displays an uneven, hand-chiseled, dimpled texture, transitioning to a smoother interior. The color palette incorporates mineral tones including light stone beige #bbb7b0, sandy taupe #9a886e, muted earthen brown #68553d, and deep shadow undertones #3c2c1c.
